Yearn Vaults is a yield aggregator built from smart contracts on the Ethereum public blockchain. Yearn Vaults automatically moves deposited funds between lending and other DeFi strategies to seek returns. Yearn Vaults operates without a central intermediary and is governed by holders of the YFI governance token.

CRV is the governance and reward token of Curve Finance, a decentralized exchange built on public blockchains. CRV is used to vote on protocol decisions, including through locking into voting-escrowed positions. CRV is distributed as liquidity mining rewards to liquidity providers.

BadgerDAO is a decentralized autonomous organization that offers yield strategies for bitcoin holders on Ethereum. BadgerDAO operates through smart contract vaults called Setts. BadgerDAO is governed by holders of the BADGER governance token.

1inch is a decentralized exchange aggregator that routes token trades across multiple decentralized exchanges to find better prices. 1inch executes swaps through smart contracts without a central intermediary. 1inch is governed by holders of the 1INCH governance token.
